env.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU

config.crop: same as s3_zoom_verify_pilot.crop (= EXP110 X4 oracle crop)
config.prompt: EXP110 config qwen.c1_prompt (unchanged, as in X4)
config.state_rule: pallet state = loaded if the center of at least one predicted block box (any block query, en) lies inside the predicted pallet box, else empty. Python rule, fixed before running.

crop.note: identical to EXP110 X4 oracle crop

c1_prompt: Find every instance of "{q}" in this image. Return JSON only, no prose: {{"objects": [{{"bbox_2d": [x1, y1, x2, y2]}}]}} with integer coordinates normalized to 0-1000 relative to image width and height. If there is no such object, return {{"objects": []}}.
